description: The plan's eight named places (docs/handoffs/ground-v2-plan-20261110.md, user shots on build 93440cb, 2026-11-10), each reviewed against the PDOK orthophoto and a city panorama.

records.label: Piet Kranenbergpad under the A10 Ringweg-Zuid, metro 50/51 and the ring railway decks
records.notes: Ortho: four BGT rail decks (Schiphol line + metro 50/51) cross the red Piet Kranenbergpad and the museum tram east-west. Panorama 001054 (under the decks) shows the path and the museum tram at grade between concrete walls, decks overhead. The inferred 73 m span at 4.853229,52.338787 was the at-grade museum tram (railSpans); the ring tracks are OSM bridge ways, so no record span is made either.

records.label: Piet Kranenbergpad: the A10 Ringweg-Zuid (north carriageway) deck over the path and the museum tram, and its embankment ends (the judgement session's 'Radarweg south abutment')
records.notes: Radarweg south abutment of the A10 (Ringweg-Zuid) deck at the Kranenbergpad: BGT motorway deck L0002.50cacd… plus the two muur lines and two h0 abutment rings. AHN DTM is NaN under the deck (the saddle G1's caps fill); grade 7.11 W / 6.88 E on the embankment, 3.34 south of the deck, path under at 0.62. Sheet panorama is on the A10; the underside is panorama TMX7316010203-002459_pano_0003_001054. a1's after frame (desktop-kranenberg-0-after) keeps shards at these deck/embankment ends.

records.label: Piet Kranenbergpad: the museum tram (Spoorlijn Aalsmeer - Amsterdam Willemspark) at the path's level beside it, north of the A10
sources: OSM way 505939744 railway (historic, Electrische Museumtramlijn Amsterdam) "Spoorlijn Aalsmeer - Amsterdam Willemspark", no bridge, no layer
Game inference before the register: railSpans.ts drew a 73.2 m span (clear 1.51 m) at 4.853229,52.338787 (lane rails-classb dde179c8b; user shot on 93440cb27)
records.notes: Museum tram (EMA, OSM 505939744) runs at grade beside the path under the ring decks: panorama 001066 shows a St Andrew's cross where a path crosses it, 001063 the tram beside the path. Level: no rail span (coordinator: Kranenbergpad is a level crossing, no rail span).

records.label: Amstelveenseweg under the A10 Ringweg-Zuid, metro 50/51 and the ring railway decks
records.notes: Ortho: the ring railway decks (magenta) and the two A10 carriageway decks (cyan) cross the Amstelveenseweg and its tram north-south at Station Zuid-west side. Both panoramas are under the decks: concrete piers and soffit over the road. The inference made no span or cut here; the record is for G1's caps.

records.label: Schinkel west bank (Jaagpad, by the Jachthavenweg) under the A10, metro 50/51 and ring railway bridges
records.notes: Ortho: two rail decks and the A10 deck over the Schinkel and its towpath (green, north-south on the west bank). Panoramas are from the decks (catenary, parapet), confirming deck level; street level from AHN on the bank. No inferred span or cut.

records.label: Overschiestraat under the A10 Ringweg-West (a covered underpass, road, cycle track and footway)
records.notes: Overschiestraat and cycleway pass under the A10 in a covered underpass: panorama 01030 is inside it (lit soffit, patterned wall). The inference made two slots (ways 7381205, 93467504) with no mouths; the record lists the west and east mouths at the A10 embankment edges.

records.label: Sportparklaan beside the A10 (sports fields; no crossing)
sources: OSM ways 443374613, 443374621, 144377965 Sportparklaan (unclassified/service), no bridge or tunnel; BGT: no overbruggingsdeel or tunneldeel within the zone (crossings:draft --area named)
records.notes: Sports fields, a works yard and the cycle path at grade beside the A10; panorama 00739 shows flat ground and a gate. No crossing: any inferred cut or span here is false.

records.label: Anthony Fokkerweg: the A10 Ringweg-Zuid link tunnel under the ring railway and metro (De Nieuwe Meer)
records.notes: BGT tunneldeel L0002.7c770e0… carries the A10 link under the ring railway; panorama 001469 is inside the dark tunnel looking at the lit mouth. Two mouths listed at the tunnel ends; the inferred third mouth at 4.843938,52.337268, 30 m outside the structure, is dropped. The zone reaches 30 m east of the structure (zoneExtra) to take in that false mouth.

records.label: Vlaardingenlaan under the A10 Ringweg-West, east to the Naaldwijkstraat junction (flat)
records.notes: Vlaardingenlaan passes under the A10 decks (cyan) and the slip-road deck; panorama 01272 under the deck shows the road, red cycle lane, piers and the embankment wall. No inferred span or cut; the record is for G1's caps.

records.label: Delflandlaan under the Cornelis Lelylaan and its tram
records.notes: Delflandlaan passes under the Cornelis Lelylaan viaduct (road and tram 1/17, east-west); panorama 00320 is in the lit underpass. The deck is recorded as a tram deck so the tram along it gets a span. No inferred span or cut here.
